en.joke: My algorithm knows me so well, it just recommended a video on how to stop scrolling. I feel seen.

people.name: Italo Calvino
people.extract: Italo Calvino was an Italian novelist and short story writer. His best-known works include the Our Ancestors trilogy (1952–1959), the Cosmicomics collection of short stories (1965), and the novels Invisible Cities (1972) and If on a winter's night a traveler (1979).
highlights: Italian novelist and short story writer.
Wrote Invisible Cities and If on a winter's night a traveler.

people.name: Roscoe Tanner
people.extract: Leonard Roscoe Tanner is an American former professional tennis player. He reached a career-high singles ranking of world No. 4 on July 30, 1979. Tanner won 16 titles throughout his career.
